shortcuts: Ctrl+Shift+M close · Ctrl+Alt+Z release · Ctrl+Shift+Q quit
info.bitrate: The most Pulsar will use; on a weak link it goes lower so the picture stays clean. Auto = chosen from the link.
info.curlabel: While you can't control the host (view-only, or the person there is using their own mouse), your pointer is shown on their screen with your name so you can point at things.
stalled: Stream stopped — the host may have stopped screen sharing.
monitor.title: Monitor
fit.title: View fit
fit.help: Fit: keeps aspect · Stretch: fills the window · 1:1: source pixels
pending.apply: Changes apply when the menu closes
info.adapt: Screen adaptation: automatically switches the host's resolution to the mode that best fits this pane (Parsec-style) and reverts it on exit. Useful for split panes.
info.pacing: Frame pacing: paces frames evenly to the display refresh (Moonlight-style) to reduce stutter — may add a little latency.
info.msens: While a game has grabbed the mouse (cursor hidden), mouse motion is sent scaled by this factor. 1× = the mouse's own speed.
info.mfree: When on, moving the cursor out of the video hands the mouse and keyboard back to this computer, and moving it back over the video takes control again without a click (like Parsec). When off, the cursor stays locked to the video; Ctrl+Alt+Z releases it. Remote desktop mode only.
info.aquality: Auto: the highest the link carries — Raw on a local network (uncompressed, ~1.6 Mbit/s), otherwise High. Standard: Opus 128 kbit/s; High: Opus 320 kbit/s; Raw: uncompressed PCM, may click on packet loss.
chat.empty: No messages in this session yet
files.help: Click a folder: enter · → send · ↓ download ("Pulsar Received")
hint.click: Click the screen to take control
info.pacing: Frame pacing: buffers 1-2 frames to smooth network/decode jitter and presents at a steady cadence. On = smoother (adds a little latency), Off = lowest latency.
info.quality: Low latency: the encoder favors speed (for gaming). Quality: better picture at the same bandwidth, slightly more latency.
info.call: Voice call: opens your microphone to the host and the host's audio to you (two-way audio).
info.statshud: Shows a small fps/latency strip at the top of the screen even while the overlay is closed.
info.ovbtn: A small draggable button on the video that opens the overlay (Parsec-style).
